rationale: The thirteenth doctrine fishes the meta itself. Every modern selector keys on PUBLISHED mag state — cuadrilla's bull, orca's prey, the pass/wave both launch on a reload window. The angler dangles a permanent one: the lure burns to 4 rounds and NEVER reloads, reading 'open' to every mag-keyed brain forever. It hangs at the edge of their selection radius, kites the committed chase TOWARD its planted guns (drag the pass across the crossfire — a dashing biter is a constant-velocity target, the one class EMA-1 lead hits perfectly), and jet-bobs constantly since it barely fires and pays no spread tax. The bait is governed by WEIGH-THE-CATCH: an online A/B the brain runs on itself — alternating lure-on/lure-off calibration windows scored by net damage (enemy health lost minus crew lost), then committing to the winning mode; 'do they bite' was the wrong question (a pass that kills the lure faster than the gallery kills the pass is a bite you don't want — the v0 tape proved it). Against health-keyed doctrines that ignore the bait it self-converts to a third hunter. Hunters run the champion's proven kit: shared target on a clock with BITER priority, crossfire slots, plant + bob, WINDOW_AUTO 360 bloom discipline, SPAS fan respect, reload at 5 in place, EMA 1, true drop. Probe record (arena 19, 9-match): 8-1 AKELA, 9-0 LERNA, 6-1 FALCONER-shrike, 4-5 BELMONTE on ground where the champion itself goes 3-5 vs orca. Named for the anglerfish's lure organ.
